name: checkbox
purpose: A single on/off choice built on a native <input type="checkbox">, restyled with appearance: none, with label, help text, mixed (indeterminate) state, required validation, and localized messages.
whenToUse: A single independent yes/no choice that is submitted with a form, such as accepting terms or opting into a newsletter.
A "select all" parent that shows a mixed state when only some children are selected.
A choice that must be confirmed before continuing (required).
whenNotToUse: Several related choices: use Checkbox Group.
One choice from a set of mutually exclusive options: use Radio Group.
A setting that takes effect immediately: use Switch.
responsive: The box stays fixed-size; the label wraps next to it and help text aligns with the label. The row is at least touch-target-min tall and the label extends the hit target.
rtl: Logical properties: the box sits at the inline start and help text is indented from the inline start in both directions. The check and minus marks are not mirrored.
theme: Unchecked: color-surface box with a color-border-strong boundary. Checked or mixed: color-primary fill with a color-on-primary mark. Invalid: color-error-fg boundary. High-contrast themes widen border-width. Forced-colors mode uses Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight, HighlightText, and GrayText with forced-color-adjust: none so the box and mark stay visible.
security: Label, help text, and messages are rendered with textContent. Validation messages never include the value. CSP-safe: no inline styles or HTML strings.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The native input carries the value for form submission when `name` is set and the box is checked.

budgets.budget: < 1 ms average in headless Chromium (target; not yet covered by the performance test)

performance.testedScale: Unit-tested per instance; not yet included in the 1,000-instance performance test.

limitations: The mixed state is presentational: the user toggling clears it, and it is never submitted.
The box itself is 1.25rem; the 24px minimum target is met by the row and the clickable label, not the box alone.
unsupported: Rendering HTML (for example links) inside the label; place links in surrounding content instead.
A read-only checkbox (native checkboxes have no read-only state).
antiPatterns: Using a checkbox for a setting that applies immediately (use Switch).
Using the mixed state as a third submitted value.
Hiding the label; the visible label is the larger click target.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/checkbox: AuiCheckbox directive ([auiCheckbox]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/checkbox: AuiCheckbox component; controlled (checked/defaultChecked + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
